data.narrative:
Precision AI is a Series A-stage company in the Drones & Autonomous sector, having raised $20M to date. The valuation universe comprises eight private peers operating in autonomous systems and drone technology, including advanced-stage companies such as Waymo, Wayve, Zipline, Joby Aviation, and Nuro. No public comparables exist in the narrow peer set.

The Peer-Median method was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage datapoints; only one adjacent-stage comparable was identified, falling short of the three-company minimum required for reliable triangulation. Consequently, the Stage-Progression method provided the primary basis for valuation. This approach applies a 2.0x multiplier to the $20M total raised proxy, treating the step-up from seed/early to Series A as a calibrated progression step. This method yields an implied valuation of $40M.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $34M (low) to $46M (median $40M), centered on the Stage-Progression result. Key uncertainties include the absence of precise Series A comparables in the Drones & Autonomous sector and reliance on a single methodological approach rather than triangulated cross-validation. The valuation is sensitive to whether Precision AI's operational stage and traction align with typical Series A progression assumptions; material variance in burn rate, technical milestones, or market timing could shift the supported range materially.
